column1: # The grammar this engine's committed answers come from. Cosmos DB for NoSQL
# has no server CI can start, so default is no image: it is Microsoft's own
# grammar of the query language, sql.g4, as the .NET SDK publishes it
# release in the source tag. The digest is the SHA-256 of testdata/sql.g4,
# which is that file byte for byte.
# columns: role, image, digest, source tag
